title: Ursodeoxycholic acid in intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy: a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

adjudication.design_quote: aggregate data from all published RCTs were compared in a post-hoc conventional fixed-effects meta-analysis, deriving summary effects by use of Mantel–Haenszel methods.
adjudication.k_quote: Given that we only received individual participant data from four of fourteen RCTs
adjudication.reason: Not IPD-only: besides the IPD analysis it reports a conventional aggregate-data pairwise meta-analysis of all published RCTs, of which there are fourteen.
